name: get_weather
description: Get the current weather conditions for a specific location. Use this when the user asks about temperature, precipitation, or conditions right now. Do NOT use it for multi-day forecasts — use get_forecast for those.

location.description: City and region, e.g. 'Naples, FL' or 'London, UK'. Be as specific as the user allows to avoid ambiguous matches.

units.description: Temperature unit system to return values in.

name: create_invoice
description: Create a new draft invoice for a customer with one or more line items. Returns the invoice id. Use this only after the customer and line items are confirmed; it does not send the invoice.

customer_id.description: The id of an existing customer, obtained from find_customer.

line_items.description: The products or services being billed.

description.description: Human-readable name of the line item.

amount_cents.description: Price for this line item in cents (USD).
